# Nazam LLC

> Practical AI automation, marketplace management, custom app development, and financial intelligence.

Nazam LLC helps businesses reduce manual work, improve marketplace operations, build useful software, and understand financial markets. The company serves small businesses, Amazon sellers, Walmart sellers, startups, entrepreneurs, and operators across the United States.
